name: bld6_integral_dalzell_companion
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_integral_dalzell and Mathlib2.calc_integral_beta_nat: x^6(1-x)^4/(1+x^2) = x^4(1-x)^4 - x^4(1-x)^4/(1+x^2) pointwise; split the integral (intervalIntegral.integral_sub), the first piece is 1/630 by calc_integral_beta_nat 4 4 and the second is 22/7 - π by calc_integral_dalzell.
